newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George appoints McKerihan CFO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George appoints McKerihan CFO.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it would appoint Steve McKerihan, who is currently St George's chief general manager of finance and credit, as chief financial officer (CFO) of the newly merged St George-Advance Bank Ltd group.
St George also said that Advance's general manager of personal banking, Keith Ward, would be appointed head of retail at the new bank.
St George's current chief general manager of group treasury, Greg Bartlett, would remain in the treasurer's position in the new bank structure.
The current managing director of Bank SA, Terry Jay, would remain in that position in the new structure. Advance bought Bank SA in 1995.
St George's current head of retail banking, Neil Berkett, had been appointed head of integration on a full time basis.
"We expect to announce the other senior appointments by mid-February," St George managing director Jim Sweeney said in a statement.

The merger of St George and Advance to create a bank with a market capitalisation of about A$4 billion cleared its final hurdle last week, when the Supreme Court of New South Wales approved Advance's capital reduction programme as part of the scheme of arrangement between the two Sydney-based banks.
